evidence.excerpt: To separate reasoning from recall, we build a 100-analyte benchmark from MassSpecGym, split by each analyte's textual footprint into in-distribution (well documented in literature) and out-of-distribution (essentially undocumented) arms.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Without tools, a frontier LLM reaches 52% Top-1 accuracy in-distribution but only 2% out-of-distribution.
